'''Karkaris''' was a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] in the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodons]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of fearless [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] aquatics.

==History==
{{Quote|Your aqua-droids are no match for the Mon Calamari. What makes you think these secret weapons you've brought from your homeworld will fare any better?|[[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]], expressing doubts about Karkaris' native wildlife|<ref name="WW" />}}
[[File:RiffTamson-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|left|180px|Riff Tamson, Karkarodon ambassador]]
Karkaris was a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] that resided in a [[Karkaris system/Legends|star system]] not far from the planet [[Dac/Legends|Mon-Cala]]. This planet was a [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodons]], a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]]. They had massive jaws, razor-sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and were fearless warriors.<ref name="WD" />

During the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Karkarodons of Karkaris developed a cybernetically enhanced biological weapon that was known as the [[Hydroid Medusa/Legends|Hydroid Medusa]]. These immense creatures incorporated armor and powerplants that turned them into near-unstoppable engines of underwater destruction.<ref name="HM">{{SWE|technology|hydroidmedusa|Hydroid Medusa}}</ref>

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, the Karkarodons, particularly [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]], joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the hope that an alliance with [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] could make their homeworld a significant galactic power.<ref name="CWG" /> At the same time, Karkarian biomechanical Hydroid Medusas were airdropped into the [[Dac/Legends|Mon-Cala]] oceans, giving the Separatists an advantage in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|civil war]] that was ongoing on the planet.<ref name="WW" /><ref name="HM" />
